answer: Guarantor admission with reputation decay stops sybil forging. Each identity needs a guarantor staking a $40 ferrous bond that rusts 5% per idle epoch; only workers get vouched. The bond returns after 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $40,000 plus upkeep each epoch. Bought accounts show on the referral graph, on a knoll where star clusters get flagged. Honest agents pay $40 once, earn $12 per epoch, so honesty costs once while forgery bleeds.
